La Plata County Fair August 5-9, 2026

Home » Arts and Entertainment » La Plata County Fair August 5-9, 2026

Posted on Jul 28, 2026

 

La Plata County Fair

 August 5–9, 2026

 La Plata County Fairgrounds • 2500 Main Ave, Durango, CO

Event Details

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 3:32
Instaread

For years, the La Plata County Fair has brought generations of families, friends and neighbors together to showcase the county’s best animals, garden products and the many fabulous foods and crafts of our outstanding community.

We encourage you to enjoy the great talent, great music, good eats and exciting entertainment with your family and friends at this ‘udderly’ extraordinary community event!

 

Looking for the ultimate guide to the La Plata County Fair? Look no further than the 2026 Fairbook! Our handy guide is loaded with all kinds of information about competitions, events, activities, entertainment, special attractions and more.

Use the 2026 Fairbook to plan your trip to beautiful Durango, Colorado and your day at the La Plata County Fair.

So what are you waiting for? Check out our 2026 Fairbook today and get ready for a fabulous time!

 

**Please note that we have a correction to the Photography Department Rules.

La Plata County Fairgrounds, Extension Lawn
25th Street & Main Avenue
Durango, Colorado 81301

Community BBQ

Saturday, August 8, 2026

Community BBQ is Back!
On Saturday, August 8th, from 11 a.m. to 2 p.m. on the Patio. Enjoy a tasty meal and continue to celebrate 150/250 Anniversaries with community members and family!

  • Tickets are available at the La Plata County Extension Office, 2500 Main Ave., Durango, CO 81301 or from a La Plata County 4-H member.
  •  Benefits the La Plata County Fair and La Plata County 4-H

Chili Cook-Off

Friday, August 7, 2026

La Plata County 4-H is hosting the first Fair Chili Cook-Off!!

Cost is only $10.00 for Adults and $5.00 for youth 12 and under.

We will have a live band, games for the kids and a silent auction! A true community event during our La Plata County Fair!

Click here to register to bring your favorite chili!! 

All proceeds will go directly to the La Plata County 4-H program.

Fair Royalty

Saturday, August 8, 2026

Since 1949, the Fair Royalty program has been transforming lives. 2026 Queen Baylie Pennington has gained confidence, public speaking skills and new friendships. The Royalty program challenges participants and inspires courage and grace.

  • August 4, 2026: Interviews
  • August 6, 2026: Speeches
  • August 8, 2026: Coronation

Royalty Application is open to all young ladies in 4-H & FFA. Applications are due by July 24 at the La Plata County Extension Office.

Talent Contest

Thursday, August 6, 2026

Watch local talent compete for prizes at the 2026 Talent Contest!

  • Thursday, August 6, 2026
  • Show begins at 7PM
  • La Plata County Fairgrounds Patio

The Talent Contest entries are due to the La Plata County Extension Office by 12 PM on Thursday, August 6, 2026.

Family Dance

Saturday, August 8, 2026

Join us fat this year’s Family Dance on the Patio at the La Plata County Fairgrounds.

  • 9pm to 12am
  • $5 per person at the door
  • La Plata County Fairgrounds Patio

Open Class Beer & Wine Competition

Time to get brewing! Anyone can enter the Open-Class Beer & Wine competition at the 2026 La Plata County Fair.

How to Enter

  • Register in person on Wednesday, August 5, between 7:30 a.m. and 6 p.m. in the La Plata County Fairgrounds Exhibit Hall.

 

La Plata County Fair – Durango, Colorado
